subject: Pet energy level data source
claim: The r806919.Wizard_1_610 client stores its shared level table in Root.wad's MagicXPConfig.xml entry: class MagicXPConfig holds 181 m_levelInfo rows of class MagicLevelInfo, covering levels 0 through 180, and the row schema includes integer m_petEnergy.
how_to_repeat: Run `typeextract --client <install> --out <temporary dump>` against your own r806919 install.
Run `client wad MagicXPConfig.xml --client <install> --type-dump <temporary dump> --wad Root.wad` and inspect the decoded root class and m_levelInfo rows.

Run `client types "class MagicXPConfig" --client <install> --type-dump <temporary dump>` and `client types "class MagicLevelInfo" --client <install> --type-dump <temporary dump>` to inspect both schemas.
Count m_levelInfo entries, confirm every entry is a MagicLevelInfo with m_petEnergy, and verify m_level lists each integer from 0 through 180 once.
evidence: The project's client decoder identified the local install as r806919.Wizard_1_610 and decoded Root.wad/MagicXPConfig.xml with root class MagicXPConfig.
The decoded m_levelInfo property contains 181 class MagicLevelInfo rows. Their m_level values are unique and contiguous from 0 through 180.
Every one of the 181 decoded rows has an m_petEnergy property.
The local type dump identifies class MagicXPConfig as hash 1299811140 with 7 properties; m_levelInfo is a list of class MagicLevelInfo pointers.
The local type dump identifies class MagicLevelInfo as hash 1812555506 with 20 properties, including int m_petEnergy.
disproof: A fresh decode and type-dump inspection from the same client revision places the shared level table elsewhere, returns a different root or row class, gives a different count or level range, or shows no integer m_petEnergy field on MagicLevelInfo.
